name: moomoo-mcp
description: moomoo MCP plugin — quotes, stock screening, news, and trading

interface.shortDescription: All-in-one finance plugin for HK/US/A-share quotes, screening, news, and trading
interface.longDescription: Connect to moomoo securities data services via moomoo MCP Server. Provides real-time quotes, K-lines, order book, time & sales, multi-factor stock screening, warrant & option screening, IPO listings, news/announcements/research reports, financial statements, valuation analysis, analyst ratings, shareholder holdings, capital flow, economic calendar, and full real/simulated trading capabilities including order placement, modification, and cancellation.
defaultPrompt: Show me Tencent's latest stock price and K-line trend
Screen HK stocks with PE below 15 and ROE above 15%
Check my portfolio positions and today's P&L
